before: Deploying pathology models through separate scripts makes preprocessing, spatial sampling and previous analysis settings difficult to inspect. This project develops ZY-Path, a local PyQt5 desktop application that connects supported PyTorch CPU inference to explicit Single image and Tiled analysis controls, spatial inspection, recorded history and export, with a separate supervisor-provided segmentation integration. The classifier achieved 90.68% accuracy and 88.59% macro-F1 on 7,180 native 224 × 224 CRC-VAL-HE-7K patches through the application’s default Pillow core, agreeing with every predicted label from the recorded reference pipeline. On 27 October 2026, revision 3a935ef passed all 508 automated tests on native Windows Qt, with no failures, errors or skipped cases. The engineering contribution is a model-aware desktop workflow with explicit crop geometry, independent task semantics and reproducible parameter restoration. The remaining usability, native-acceptance, performance and deployment work is defined in Section 4.5.3.
